thread:
sam: Heads-up — we're flipping the variant-pin feature in the console today. It allows tenants to pin route-level routing to a specific runtime (eg v1 legacy vs v2). Need a quick call on quota attribution semantics.

priya: Question — if someone pins a route to v1, do we count against the tenant's legacy quota or the new routing quota? We saw confusion last time.

tj: I think defaulting to legacy quota hides migration telemetry. Alternative: always count against the runtime actually serving and attach a `pin=true` tag so we can separate pinned traffic in dashboards.

megan: Telemetry note: when pinning launched for the batch job last quarter we got a sudden jump in the v1 line — it doubled because pinned traffic was indistinguishable. We should avoid that.

sanjay: Proposal for precedence: 1) console pin (route-level) -> route quota/legacy by default, 2) explicit header `X-API-Version` overrides when allowed, 3) fallback routing. Also add `pin_reason` metadata (`console`/`header`/`fallback`).

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: pin-service @prod at 23:00 UTC. Notifying: @sam @priya @tj @megan @sanjay :rocket:

priya: UX request: console copy must be explicit: "Pinning to v1 routes traffic to the legacy runtime and will count against your legacy quota." Link to migration docs. Also add an undo CTA.

sam: Edge case: if a tenant toggles a pin while requests are in-flight we must not switch quotas mid-request. Acceptance: routing decision + quota tagging must be atomic at request start.

megan: I'll add a dashboard tile: "Pinned traffic (by tenant)" plus a "quota delta" metric and a trace filter on `pin_reason`. Also want a small alert if pinned traffic > 20% of route for 12h.

tj: Implementation snippet for header support: ```http
# client can send an opt-in header to request v2 explicitly
X-API-Version: v2
X-Pin-Variant: v1  # server will surface this on console as overridden_by=header
``` Question: if header conflicts with console pin, which wins?

priya: Console wins — tenant admin intent should be respected. Add telemetry tag `overridden_by=console` when console pin supersedes header. :thumbsup:

sam: Good. Action items: priya update UX copy + undo CTA, sanjay codify routing precedence in policy repo, megan add dashboard/alert, tj add header lint + server atomicity check. We'll monitor metrics for 24h post-deploy and rollback plan if legacy quota TPS spikes.
